Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Lewis and Gus Portrait
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portraits of Lewis and Gus, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking For Love[/url] mod (Originally [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/366]Siv's Marriage Mod[/url]) that makes those 2 characters romanceable (also compatible with the vanilla game ).


*Make sure you have PyTK mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size]


I made a CP version for Lewis and Gus that should work for everyone.
If you encountered 2Dtexture Error while using the CP mod, please check if you have other mods that change those 2 character's portraits, find the mod that changes their portrait, and delete the Lewis.png or Gus.png from that mod's folder.

For people who have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] mod or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking For Love[/url] mod, there's also the replacement file version. The replacement file version prevents assets from getting loaded two times and prevents 2Dtexture Error in some situations. Choose whichever version you prefer/whichever version works for you. Check readme.txt in the folder for details.


And Portraiture version for them both, I've never used Portraiture, so please let me know if the portraits doesn't work.



The original art style belongs to DCBurger: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66555116]tryptan[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking For Love[/url] mod belongs to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48380238]foggywizard[/url] and the original author of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/366]Siv's Marriage Mod[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33868135]sivolobwho[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
